title: Davis at the Aerospace Corporation in Huntsville: few PhD physicists, all doing engineering

tellings.quote: I worked for the aerospace corporation for four and a half years.

plain: A physicist named Eric Davis says he worked for four and a half years at the Aerospace Corporation, a research company serving the US military, in Huntsville, Alabama. He says there were few physicists with doctorates there, and those few were all doing engineering work. He tells it to show how little room there was for deeper physics research in that world.
